claims.text: The CNN model outperforms the RNN model with a macro-F1 score of 0.80, making it the best performing model in the context of discriminating between offensive and non-offensive posts.
In the context of discriminating between insults and threats, the CNN system also achieved higher performance than the BiLSTM with a macro-F1 score of 0.69.
